mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.perms FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.perms IS NOT NULL AND m.perms != '' AND m.deleted = 0
SELECT role_id FROM sys_user_role WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_key FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0

SELECT ur.user_id FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE r.role_key = #{roleKey} AND r.status = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND u.status = 0 AND u.deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.id ASC LIMIT 1
